jstall.changelog: `--ssh` mode now works when running jstall on Windows: replaced the `sh -c "ssh ..."` shell wrapper with a direct `ProcessBuilder` invocation, so no local Unix shell is required. The remote host still needs to be Linux/Mac. · `jstall.jar` - Executable JAR file (requires Java 21+) · `jstall` - Standalone launcher script (Unix/Linux/macOS) · `jstall-minimal.jar` - Minimal executable JAR (SapMachine only, see note below) · `jstall-minimal` - Minimal launcher script (SapMachine only, see note below)
